'''Sarah Danforth''' is an [[ally]]. She first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and is the only ally who isn't updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. Sarah can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[Independence Square]] or, when combining [[Miskatonic Horror]] with [[Innsmouth Horror]], at the [[Marsh Refinery]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Focus]]

Draw 1 [[Exhibit item]] when Sarah Danforth joins you.
